metadata.title: भील आदिवासी साबुत लहसुन के साथ कैसे पकाते हैं मटन । Mutton cooked with whole head of garlic
metadata.description:
We bring this episode of tribal kitchen straight from Jhabua for you. Jhabua is home to one of the largest tribes in India, Bhil. We got a chance to meet a family that was preparing a feast of mutton. So we thought we will bring to you the entire process of how they cook the mutton, as the preparation is something we are sure you have never seen before.

#Mutton_Recipe #Nonveg_Recipe #Bhil_Tribe
